howItWorks.title: AI-Powered Installation
howItWorks.subtitle: Don't know how to code? No problem! Let your AI assistant automatically install the entire system for you with just 1 Copy-Paste.
howItWorks.aiBoxDesc: Open the Antigravity AI application. Copy the magic prompt below into the chat box and press Enter:
howItWorks.promptDemo:
Hi AI, I want to install the Demo version of the Marketing Dashboard. Please open the Terminal and run these commands automatically:

1. `npm install -g {'@'}kjantigravity/cli`
2. `kj-kit demo`

Requirements:
- If prompted for Yes/No, automatically select Yes.
- If my machine lacks Node.js, stop and provide the direct download link.
- After downloading, run the server startup command and give me the http://localhost link to access it immediately!
howItWorks.promptPro:
Hi AI, I want to install the Full version of the Marketing Dashboard. Please open the Terminal and run these commands automatically:

1. `npm install -g {'@'}kjantigravity/cli`
2. `kj-kit init -k marketing`

Requirements:
- Guide me to enter the License Token when prompted.
- If my machine lacks Node.js, stop and provide the direct download link.
- After downloading, run the server startup command and give me the http://localhost link to access it immediately!

coreCommitment.title: Core Commitment: 100% Local, Zero Data Collection
coreCommitment.desc: KJ Studio Marketing Dashboard is designed with a Local-first architecture (Running entirely on your personal machine). We do not have a central server to track, store, or read your content, marketing campaigns, or customer data. Your data belongs to you and resides only on your hard drive.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.desc: Due to the nature of local software, we collect extremely minimal information:
list: Purchase Information: Name, Email, phone number (if any) when you make a payment transaction to buy a License.

Authentication Information: The system calls the GitHub API to authenticate your GitHub PAT access (to ensure you are the buyer). This process occurs directly between your computer and GitHub servers.

sections.title: 2. What Do We NOT Collect?
sections.desc: We absolutely DO NOT collect, transmit, or store the following information:
list: Article content, images, digital assets you create in the .antigravity folder.
Your access history or interactions inside the Marketing Dashboard.
Source code or data from other personal files on your computer.

sections.title: 3. Cookies and Tracking
sections.desc: This Landing Page website may use basic cookies (such as Cloudflare Web Analytics) to count the number of visitors. These tools only collect aggregated, anonymous data and are not used to identify you personally.

sections.title: 4. Information Sharing
sections.desc: We promise not to sell, rent, or trade your purchase information (Email, Name) with any third parties for marketing purposes.
